# Interlogistik Transport

> Interlogistik Transport S.R.L. is a Romanian freight forwarder founded in 2011 and based in Alba Iulia.
> It organises international road freight between Romania and all of Europe in both directions, plus Turkey and the Middle East:
> full truckload (FTL), groupage (LTL) and project cargo, with fixed partner carriers and no intermediaries.
> GPS tracking on every load, CMR insurance, RO e-Transport compliant, a quote within one working day. Contact: office@interlogistik-transport.com

## Main pages

- [Home (English)](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/): services, lanes, tracking, commitments and FAQ for road freight Romania ⇄ Europe.
- [Acasă (română)](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/): the same homepage in Romanian.
- [Request a quote](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/#quote): quote form, a dispatcher replies within one working day.
- [Cere ofertă](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/#quote): the quote form in Romanian.

## Lane pages (English)

- [Romania ⇄ Germany](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/romania-germany-road-freight/): Interlogistik moves freight by road between Romania and Germany in both directions: full truckload (FTL), groupage and project cargo.
- [Romania ⇄ Austria](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/romania-austria-road-freight/): Interlogistik moves freight by road between Romania and Austria in both directions, with FTL, groupage and project cargo.
- [Romania ⇄ Italy](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/romania-italy-road-freight/): Interlogistik moves freight by road between Romania and Italy in both directions: FTL, groupage and project cargo, anywhere on the Italian mainland.
- [Romania ⇄ Poland](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/romania-poland-road-freight/): Interlogistik moves freight by road between Romania and Poland in both directions, by FTL, groupage and project cargo.
- [Romania ⇄ Greece](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/romania-greece-road-freight/): Interlogistik moves freight by road between Romania and Greece in both directions, with regular daily departures: FTL, groupage and project cargo.
- [Romania ⇄ Croatia](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/romania-croatia-road-freight/): Interlogistik moves freight by road between Romania and Croatia in both directions: FTL, groupage and project cargo.
- [Romania ⇄ Slovenia](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/romania-slovenia-road-freight/): Interlogistik moves freight by road between Romania and Slovenia in both directions, by FTL, groupage and project cargo.

- [România ⇄ Germania](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/transport-romania-germania/): Interlogistik transportă marfă rutier între România și Germania, în ambele sensuri: FTL (camion complet), grupaj și project cargo.
- [România ⇄ Austria](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/transport-romania-austria/): Interlogistik transportă marfă rutier între România și Austria, în ambele sensuri, cu FTL, grupaj și project cargo.
- [România ⇄ Italia](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/transport-romania-italia/): Interlogistik transportă marfă rutier între România și Italia, în ambele sensuri: FTL, grupaj și project cargo, oriunde în Italia continentală.
- [România ⇄ Polonia](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/transport-romania-polonia/): Interlogistik transportă marfă rutier între România și Polonia, în ambele sensuri, prin FTL, grupaj și project cargo.
- [România ⇄ Grecia](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/transport-romania-grecia/): Interlogistik transportă marfă rutier între România și Grecia, în ambele sensuri, cu plecări regulate zilnic: FTL, grupaj și project cargo.
- [România ⇄ Croația](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/transport-romania-croatia/): Interlogistik transportă marfă rutier între România și Croația, în ambele sensuri: FTL, grupaj și project cargo.
- [România ⇄ Slovenia](https://www.interlogistik-transport.com/ro/transport-romania-slovenia/): Interlogistik transportă marfă rutier între România și Slovenia, în ambele sensuri, prin FTL, grupaj și project cargo.
